title: Rule sources
intro: Rules files Floorbit fetches on a schedule, on top of the lists it ships. The higher a source, the more it wins when two name the same application; the event's own changes win over all. A fetch that fails keeps the last good copy. With no internet, the built-in lists still work.
freezeHelp: Stop fetching during the event, so the numbers don't move. The copies stay in use.
name: Name
urlHelp: https, a rules file (version 1, "applications") or a plain list of domains.
keptCopy: {{error}} The last good copy stays in use.
removeAsk: Remove the source {{name}}? Its applications go too.
ownList: Maintained by BitsAndBricks and signed: Floorbit only uses it when the signature checks out. Always last, so your own sources win.
